changes: Retain independent full-image SHA256 for every installation load. On Windows amd64 without AVX, use a fresh fixed OS CNG SHA256 object instead of Go generic compression. Other CPUs/platforms retain Go SHA256. Every create/write/finish/destroy failure rejects verification; objects are destroyed on digest/read failure.

Separate whole-image read duration from digest lifecycle/write duration in fixed KRD9 local diagnostics. Includes journal and both native children and selected backend. Does not grant readiness, replace a fresh heartbeat or change any input authority.

investigation.fullImageProbes: 5 bounded read-only installed-image probes: memory SHA256 10.051-13.185ms, file hash+ACL 14.5-64.846ms; directory opens 0.509-1.724ms, metadata open/decode 0-0.568ms. Wall durations include scheduling.
investigation.discarded: 256KiB/1MiB/4MiB reads and sequential-scan combinations produced no clear broad improvement; retained the original 256KiB read bound.

benchmarks.scope: Three iterations per backend on A. purego forces software Go SHA256 while Windows retains OS feature selection. Not a B benchmark or a controlled simulation of its CPU. GODEBUG runs did not reproduce a slower Go hash here and are not used as fallback evidence.

investigation.targetCPU: Non-AVX amd64 uses generic Go SHA256 in the selected runtime. Whether B uses the alternative path and how much it helps remain pending physical profiles.

validation.go: Full go test ./... -timeout=120s passed with CGO_ENABLED=0 and the deployment offlineGo runtime overlay.
validation.hash: CNG agrees with Go across block/chunk boundaries and 9MiB images; corruption, truncation, growth and reader errors rejected. Provider create/write/finish/destroy failure rejection and exactly-once close tested.
validation.framing: KRD9 journal/input/release roundtrip, truncated payloads, reserved bytes, invalid numeric diagnostics, following-frame alignment and old native startup/heartbeat tests passed.
validation.frontend: 104/104 tests and native production build passed.
validation.package: Workspace archive, icon, native installer and offline application setup verification passed.
validation.installation: Both installed g504, matching UI/agent build, protected input READY, authenticated CONNECTED and exact peer UPDATED receipt.
validation.race: Skipped: CGO disabled in deployment environment.

limitations: Installation/startup snapshot only; g504 physical latency effect and recurrence require the next crossing test.
Both control.previous.jsonl sources are incomplete; no fault means none observed in this current-build collection.
Local software-path benchmark does not prove the B CPU cause or improvement; split hash read/compute profiles are required.
apiChanges: Fixed local KRD9 diagnostic extension; no network protocol/public API changes.
